'''Stivastin''', designated '''Specimen #71''', was a [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was experimented on by the [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Gorima]] during Gorima's efforts to create an [[Infinite Army]] by fusing [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] technology to living beings. Stivastin broke free when Gorima's lab, [[Genetics Laboratory G-1]] on the ocean floor of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]], was damaged by missiles and began to flood. He attacked a group of independent operatives and was [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="Depths" />
